title: Pan-Seared Gyoza with Japanese Corn
description: A twist on traditional pan-fried gyoza, served with a sweet and savory Japanese corn accompaniment. This recipe combines the best of Japanese and old-fashioned flavors.
instructions: 1. Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add ground pork and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add soy sauce and cook for 1 minute.
5. Place gyoza wrappers on a flat surface and fill each with about 1 tablespoon of the pork mixture.
6. Fold the wrappers in half to form a triangle, pressing the edges to seal.
7. Add the gyoza to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
8. Meanwhile, heat a small amount of oil in a separate pan and sauté the corn until lightly browned.
9. Serve the gyoza with the Japanese corn accompaniment.
10. Season with old-fashioned salt and black pepper to taste.
